note: Gated countryside campground between Morinville and Onoway, 5 km north of Hwy 642 on Range Road 13, with an on-site caretaker. Sites are 30, 35 or 40 ft wide and 65 ft long, each with a picnic table and firepit; the first three rows are 30-amp and the top row 50-amp. Nature trail and a catch-and-release trout pond (no swimming). Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays. Quads, motorbikes and ATVs are not allowed. --Claude
